description: PAID ($0.001 image/PDF, $0.005 video): turn a URL into a persistent public artifact. png/jpeg/pdf are a screenshot or PDF and include free OG metadata; mp4/webm scroll-record the page. Settles gasless USDC over x402 — but an unpaid call runs free while the rolling per-IP allowance lasts, so just call it.

durationMs.description: Video formats only. Scroll duration in milliseconds, 1-30000; default 5000.

format.description: Artifact format, default png. png/jpeg/pdf = screenshot/PDF at $0.001 (POST /v1/x402/capture); mp4/webm = scroll video at $0.005 (POST /v1/x402/video). The 402 challenge states the exact price for the format you chose.

fullPage.description: Image/PDF only. true captures the whole scrollable page (default false: viewport only).

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL of the page to process, e.g. https://example.com/

name: webcap_capture
